findings.evidence: Lines 375–381 expose the body and immediately publish the identical `_def` theorem; all PR uses reason through the named evaluation lemmas.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]`; downstream consumers can rewrite with `primeDiscriminantPrime_def` or the specialized simp lemmas.
findings.issue: `primeDiscriminantPrime` is marked `@[expose]` even though `primeDiscriminantPrime_def` and the even/odd evaluation lemmas provide its public unfolding API.

findings.evidence: Lines 46–55 define `ramifiedPrimes` and provide the exact `Iff.rfl` normal form, but no simp annotation.
findings.issue: The defining membership characterization `mem_ramifiedPrimes_iff` lacks `@[simp]`, so simplification cannot reduce membership in the new set to its canonical predicate.

summary: The new interface unnecessarily exposes an implementation body and omits the normal-form annotation on its principal membership theorem.
